description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Notification entities, including methods to find notifications by event or user, and to find the most recent notification for an event.

classes.name: NotificationRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Notification entities, providing custom query methods.

methods.name: findFirstByEventOrderByCreatedDesc
methods.description: Finds the most recent Notification for a given Event.

methods.name: findByEvent
methods.description: Finds all Notifications associated with a specific Event.

methods.name: findByUser
methods.description: Finds all Notifications associated with a specific User.
